patterns: APPSC asks AP Buddhist sites as one-liners: biggest stupa in AP (Amaravati), Siddharthaka Chaitya = Guntupalli, Bhairavakonda caves, sect-centre pairs (Purvasaila/Aparasaila).
Cave-to-dynasty/feature recall dominates other PSCs: Elephanta/Ellora = Rashtrakutas, Trimurti = Elephanta, Kanheri = 100+ caves and 11-headed Avalokiteshvara, Bagh = Gupta paintings.
University founders are a stock item: Vikramashila = Dharmapala (asked many times), Somapura = Dharmapala, Vallabhi = Gujarat.
App adds stupa 'largest/oldest' rankings and recent-excavation trivia (Vaishya Tekri, B.R. Mani) that are disputed or beyond PYQ depth.
